title: CoreWeave Meta Deal Deepens AI Hyperscaler Ties And Capacity Commitments
title_zh: CoreWeave Meta 交易加深了 AI 超大规模企业的联系和容量承诺
summary: CoreWeave (NasdaqGS:CRWV) has expanded its long term AI infrastructure agreement with Meta Platforms, extending contracted visibility through 2032.
summary_zh: CoreWeave（纳斯达克GS：CRWV）扩大了与 Meta Platforms 的长期人工智能基础设施协议，将合同可见性延长至 2032 年。

title: Apple Weighs Major AI Deal As Investors Reassess Growth And Valuation
title_zh: 随着投资者重新评估增长和估值，苹果考虑重大人工智能交易
summary: Apple, ticker NasdaqGS:AAPL, is reportedly weighing a major AI acquisition that would depart from its usual deal making approach. The potential move comes as Tim Cook prepares to hand the CEO role to John Ternus and as questions continue about Apple's position in AI.
summary_zh: 据报道，苹果公司（股票代码 NasdaqGS：AAPL）正在考虑一项重大的人工智能收购，这将背离其通常的交易方式。这一潜在举措发生之际，蒂姆·库克(Tim Cook)正准备将首席执行官一职交给约翰·特努斯(John Ternus)，而且人们对苹果在人工智能领域的地位的质疑仍...

title: Stock Market Today, May 4: ADT Falls as Apollo Exits Stake Through 102 Million-Share Offering
title_zh: 今日股市，5 月 4 日：Apollo 通过 1.02 亿股发行退出股份，ADT 下跌
summary: Apollo’s exit puts a large block of ADT shares into the market, while the company’s concurrent buyback absorbs only part of the selling pressure.
summary_zh: Apollo 的退出将大量 ADT 股票推向市场，而该公司同时进行的回购仅吸收了部分抛售压力。

title: Carlyle Expands Healthcare Push With Majority RCM Deal
title_zh: 凯雷通过 RCM 多数股权交易扩大医疗保健业务
summary: Carlyle acquired majority stakes in Knack RCM and EqualizeRCM to build a new revenue cycle management platform.
summary_zh: 凯雷收购了 Knack RCM 和 EqualizeRCM 的多数股权，以建立新的收入周期管理平台。

title: Does KKR & Co (KKR) Offer a Compelling Risk/Reward Opportunity?
title_zh: KKR & Co (KKR) 是否提供了令人信服的风险/回报机会？
summary: 1 Main Capital, a boutique investment firm, recently released its first-quarter 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter is available to download here.
summary_zh: 精品投资公司 1 Main Capital 最近发布了 2026 年第一季度投资者信。该信函的副本可在此处下载。
